_README: A standalone API test — no browser involved at any point.
There is no flag for this and no separate command. wowlidator looks at the steps:
if nothing in the flow needs a page, it never opens Chrome. You still get the
same HTML report, run history and flake detection as a UI test.
Because there is no browser, calls go out through plain fetch and carry no
session. A flow that needs to be authenticated should either log in with its
own request step (below), or live alongside UI steps — in which case it
EVERY CASE NEEDS AN ASSERTION. A request whose status nobody checks passes
whether the endpoint returns the right data or a 500.
name: orders api
_setup: Authenticate once and keep the token for every step below.

setup.intent: Sign in and keep the token

setup._: Setup failures abort the flow — a test whose login did not work cannot tell you anything. Note the token is masked in the report; the run still uses the real value.

steps._: Reading it back is the difference between proving the endpoint accepted the call and proving it did something.

steps.intent: The order stored the SKU we sent

steps._: No 'value' — the id is server-assigned, so all we can honestly assert is that it is there.
The negative case. A 4xx does not fail a request step, which is exactly what makes this expressible.

steps.intent: A missing order is a 404, not a 500 and not an empty 200

_teardown: Always runs, including after a failure above.
